title: Migration 4 — enables RLS on the tables the base schema left without it (apply-only)
description: Applies migration 4 on a disposable PostgreSQL 17 cluster. This migration ships NO ROLLBACK file, so reversibility cannot be proven and is not claimed: the fixture covers what is provable — that 4 applies cleanly against a real cluster on the major production runs. It existed outside the harness's old *_HARDENING.sql denominator (defect D6), so before this fixture a fully green run said nothing whatever about it while looking identical to one that covered it. The absence of a rollback is printed on every run rather than left to be inferred from a silence.
